review.method: Independent comparison of all 80 translations with original disc source and eight adjacent context rows. Corrected two ongoing-attack status labels and restored required No-label spacing. Verified hit-count inclusivity, airborne restrictions, marking meaning and preset consistency. Native disassembly confirms consecutive Yes/No labels and time-limit, degree and seconds fragment ordering via base-plus-offset source addresses. All line-break controls preserved; visual fit remains untested.

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256.

notes.641: Preset names repeat previous models' sets; exact spellings matched against batch 008 during independent meaning review.
notes.662: The required approach and evasion must both happen without landing; stay airborne retains that condition.
notes.667: Attack without descending to the ground; stay airborne expresses the training restriction.
notes.670: At least five Main Weapon shots must hit, not merely be fired.
notes.671: Dodge and score at least five Main Weapon hits; both requirements remain.
notes.673: Automatic marking applies during enemy detection when an enemy enters the Radar marking range; do not replace marking with an unsupported weapon lock-on interpretation.
notes.676: Native callers 0x114f6-0x11516 and 0x1152e-0x11550 print Yes and No consecutively without resetting X. Preserve the three leading spaces to separate the labels; removing them joins YesNo. Native cached ASCII spaces use the same 20-pixel advance as source fullwidth spaces.
notes.677: Native caller 0x19d2e-0x19d5c prints this prefix, integer time limit via 0x5c1c, then suffix 678. Keep trailing space. The zero-reference source address is constructed as base 0x8c13dfbc plus 0xa8.
notes.678: Seconds suffix after a numeric time limit; leading space and closing parenthesis complete 677.
notes.689: The subject whose state is shown is omitted in the source status labels 689-697; retain generic state labels, as either unit may be selected in programming conditions.
notes.694: Independent review restored the ongoing attack state in rows 694/695. The source describes attacking in progress, not the name of an attack command.
notes.698: Two programming parameter labels; preserve the line break.
notes.699: Native caller 0x225d2-0x2260c prints the integer angle, this degree suffix plus newline, then a decimal distance and unchanged ASCII m suffix. Keep the newline and leading English space. Its source address is base 0x8c13e14c plus 0xf3.
notes.703: Native caller 0x22760-0x22774 prints the integer turn angle followed by this degree suffix. Preserve the leading English space. Its source address is base 0x8c13e14c plus 0x112; other angle consumers use the same fragment.
notes.709: Acceleration time is duration, not a clock time.
notes.712: Native caller 0x22c56-0x22c6c prints a decimal acceleration duration via 0x5dbc followed by this seconds unit. Keep the leading space. Its source address is base 0x8c13e14c plus 0x156; other duration consumers reuse it.
notes.713: Vertical firing direction and firing-angle correction are separate parameter lines. The correction is not weapon accuracy.
notes.714: Ground-target firing direction; Anti-Ground preserves the menu's category label.
notes.715: Air-target firing direction; Anti-Air preserves the menu's category label.
notes.716: The source starts with a newline to align the firing-angle parameter under a previous dynamic field.
notes.718: The source omits what remains in the slot; Remaining preserves that omission without inventing ammunition or charges.
notes.719: Ammunition count suffix; retain the source's leading newline.
notes.720: Your Unit Status is distinct from Enemy Status in adjacent 721; own-unit subject is explicit in the source.
